subject: AWS storefront: hero, pricing, onboarding copy
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS storefront: hero, pricing, onboarding copy

Team —

Looping everyone in to get a short review of the AWS product page assets for Acme Analytics (related to DEAL-3429). We have a seller listing draft in the attached doc and a preliminary pricing matrix. The ask: please skim and respond with the minimal set of edits we should push to the AWS listing this week so we can submit the offer for co-sell review by Friday.

Key questions:
- Hero line: does this clearly differentiate from other embeddings/ML infra claims?
- Pricing: the matrix has a usage-based tier + reserved commit; any red flags for AWS pricing narrative?
- Onboarding: the checklist includes a short trial flow + AMI notes — is that sufficient for the marketplace dev experience?

Attachments: aws-hero-draft_v3.docx (docx), pricing-matrix_acme.xlsx (xlsx), seller-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)

I kept the product description short — 2 bullets + example use case. If we can finalize edits in half a day I’ll push the update to the shared doc and ping Seller Central.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Partner GTM & Marketplace Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS storefront: hero, pricing, onboarding copy

Jonas — thanks for the draft. Quick inline notes below (keeps editing light so we can ship):

1) Hero line — current: “Fast, cost-efficient inference for custom embeddings”
   Suggest: “Production-grade inference for embeddings — predictable latency, lower unit cost.”
   Rationale: call out the production differentiator (latency + cost) rather than the generic “fast”.

2) Subhead (1 line) — add: “Works on hosted, dedicated, and private deployment.” It helps co-sell teams see the deployment flexibility up front.

3) Bullets — tighten to three outcome-focused bullets:
   • Reduce per-token inference cost with smart batching and KV caching
   • Ship reproducible quality with model versioning & rollouts
   • Enterprise controls: VPC, KMS & audit logs

4) Pricing blurb — avoid specific commit math on the product page. Keep pricing copy directional: “Usage-based and reserved options for predictable throughput.” Move the detailed matrix to the pricing footnote (link).

5) Onboarding/AMI note — add a one-line callout: “AMI available for private deployments; contact seller-ops for image access.” That reduces support friction.

6) CTAs — prefer two CTAs: “Start free trial” (primary) and “Contact sales / Request private deployment” (secondary). Avoid >2 CTAs on hero.

I attached a redline of aws-hero-draft_v3.docx with in-line suggestions.

Minor: watch the claims around multi-region failover — we should avoid guaranteeing SLAs in the listing copy (leave that to the SLA docs).

I’ll review once you push the small wording changes.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace & Growth
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: aws-hero-draft_v3.docx (docx) — redline version attached]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RE: AWS storefront: hero, pricing, onboarding copy

Forwarding this thread to Acme contact list for a quick alignment on the trial flow and AMI access — we need their confirmation before we publish the listing.

-------- Forwarded Message --------
From: David Chen <david.chen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS storefront: hero, pricing, onboarding copy

Aditya — thanks for the call this morning. A couple notes from Acme:

• The trial needs to include a 30-day evaluation with token limits and an easy path to upgrade to a reserved commit. Can you confirm the experience described will map to our internal sales journey?
• AMI access: we will need a private AMI and a short runbook describing the VPC peering steps.
• Co-sell listing: our field team wants the success metric example (query latency at 95th pct) included in the product page. Is adding a single example metric OK?

If you can share the updated hero and onboarding checklist I’ll get this to our Seller Ops and legal for an expedited review.

-David
David Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics

[Attachment: seller-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: David Chen <david.chen@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T13:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS storefront: hero, pricing, onboarding copy

David — great to hear these points. Short answers below then we’ll sync on the doc: 

• Trial UX: yes — we will publish a 30-day trial with token limits and an in-console upgrade path to reserved commitment. The product page will link to the pricing footnote for commit tiers.
• AMI & runbook: we’ll share a private AMI and a 2-page runbook with VPC peering steps. Aditya will coordinate image access with your Seller Ops.
• Example metric: we can include a single example (e.g., “95th pct latency < 120ms for single-GPU inference on 2k tokens”) labelled as an example and dependent on workload; Kimberly flagged we should not make SLA guarantees.

Next steps: Jonas — please push the hero update + CTA changes Kimberly suggested to the shared doc (link below) and include the updated checklist. I’ll get the go-ahead to submit to Seller Central after Acme confirms the AMI-ready dates.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AwsStorefrontCopy/edit

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pricing-matrix_acme.xlsx (xlsx) — submitted for internal review]
